scenes.contextualRelevance: Jimmy Wales' words suggest that passion and a clear purpose can outweigh initial concerns about business models, especially when driven by a desire to create something beneficial for the public.

narrativeProgression.description: Jimmy Wales discusses how the decision of whether Wikipedia should be for-profit or non-profit was secondary to him.
He emphasizes that his focus was on creating a successful, high-quality encyclopedia, with the organizational structure being a later consideration.
Jimmy Wales highlights that he didn't have a clear plan initially but believed a non-profit model made the most sense for achieving his goals.

scenes.thematicElements: Origins of Wikipedia, non-profit model, founder's vision.
scenes.title: Opening Vision

activities.description: Jimmy Wales continues to speak directly to the camera, discussing the early vision for a high-quality encyclopedia and the challenges of sustainability.
He explains the decision to avoid advertising on Wikipedia and why fundraising became the chosen method.
Jimmy Wales shifts to a personal note, emphasizing his commitment to the non-profit model by not taking a salary or expenses.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I did not clearly have in mind it should be a charity, it should be a for-profit.
That was really secondary. It should be whatever it needed to be in order to be successful,
in order to be what I wanted it to be. And at the time I didn't know really what does that mean,
how are we going to get there? My name is Jimmy Wales. We had a very strong vision of a good high
quality in cyclopedia. Thinking about well how do we sustain this? How do we make this work?
Putting it into a nonprofit and asking for donations seemed like the reasonable way to go.
When people ask why don't we have advertising in Wikipedia? So there's a lot of very practical
reasons, but one of the reasons is when you're at Wikipedia, I want your experience to be
it's a place of quiet reflection, of learning, of thinking. From the Wikimedia Foundation,
I don't take a salary and I also don't even take expenses. I think it's very important that I'm
able to say quite clearly, look when I'm asking you for money, I'm not asking you for money for myself,
I'm asking you for money for the foundation which is the team who supports this amazing community
